correctness.rationale: For the explicitly given GP(10,2) edge list, exhaustive integer graph enumeration confirms 20 unique neighbor triangles and 60 free edges and connectivity, hence collapse to graph with 21 cycles. Exact 20x6 rooted local-map enumeration exhausts all automorphisms; 60 A5 rotations and central antipodal coset make all 120. Signed permutation traces on every oriented simplex provide the four rational character values per coset. Half-sum/difference and A5 rational characters yield W6+V5 even, 2V5 odd. All computations are finite and exactly reproduced by the bundled checker; the proof does not assume experiments extend to infinite graphs.

value.rationale: The dodecahedral graph is a standard geometrically and combinatorially canonical highly symmetric cubic graph. Its rational H1 character distinguishes the 6D and 5D rotation factors, computes the central involution parity 11/10, and excludes invariant homology classes; none can be recovered from the previously known Betti number 21 or circle-wedge homotopy type. It is an exact and motivated finite equivariant invariant with transparent exhaustive evidence; no downstream result is claimed.
